lightgbm_diagnostics.interpretation: Joint tree-path splits are descriptive, not causal interaction estimates.

market.limitation: Ten Phase 1 T-60 games; raw implied probability includes book margin.

answers.Do position models improve on pooled mod: No overall. Position logistic log loss 0.3835 versus frozen pooled logistic 0.3831 and hierarchy 0.3804; see position table.
answers.Does LightGBM materially beat hierarchy?: No; it fails at least one predeclared gate.
answers.Does xTD add within a position?: No clear 2024 log-loss gain. RB xTD-minus-core log loss +0.0016; WR xTD-minus-core log loss +0.0000; TE xTD-minus-core log loss +0.0008. Negative values favor xTD; small differences are not strong evidence.
answers.Does the OOF ensemble materially improve: No; it fails at least one predeclared gate.
answers.Does market still outperform best footba: Yes on 223 matched 2024 T-60 player quotes; this is a narrow sample.
